title: DT&AI PageSpec
description: A generation-ready page specification: an ordered graph of section-type node instances, each carrying a content payload validated against a dedicated per-type schema, plus page-level theme/meta.

theme.description: Only the single measured, generation-approved production theme is enumerated. No dark-mode variant was measured on any of the 34 routes; do not add one to this enum without a real measurement pass (see README Known Gaps).
